thesis.note: Hold TSLA (growth equity) and SPCX (space). No idle capital, so nothing is allocated. A hypothetical stock dollar under the standing pin would go to TSLA, the side $1.21 light, and would not be raised by selling SPCX: the one-way ticket is $0.61, under $1, inside the 1% band, and selling the Flight 14 name into a headline to buy a -3.32% TSLA day is the noise this cadence avoids. A hypothetical reopen of the 40% sleeve — not proposed — would lead with STRC and SATA (tight ~1 bp books, near par, yield above cash, daily-accrual vote ahead; ex-dates already passed so no capture rush), then diversify miners. IREN (-4.80%, 2.4 bp) and RIOT (-4.87%, 4.6 bp) are the sharpest liquid miner tapes. MSTR is liquid and second to that credit pair, not the default. Chosen because they are the only names the Chairman allows on the book and they are inside the pin — not because they were already owned. Themes mapped: TSLA growth, SPCX space. Digital credit, miners, AI, nuclear, gold, and HYPD were considered and not chosen.

risk.note: Do not trade. BP $0.03 is below the $1 minimum, so any new name needs a sale. The $0.61 TSLA/SPCX gap is liquid (TSLA 2.8 bp, SPCX 2.0 bp) and still under both the $1 floor and the $3.24 1% band. Reopening the BTC complex by selling the pin would be a ~40% NAV policy reversal, not a small ticket, and it would breach the Chairman lock. STRC and SATA liquidity is not the risk: both are ~1 bp at par. STRK at ~51 bp would be a liquidity cut even on a reopen. HYPD ~77 bp and EVGO's penny book are not suitable first dollars. No concentration inside the allowed book beyond the intentional 50/50 pin. Multi-miner overlap is not a risk block; there is no miner position to concentrate. Primary margin was not used.

critic.note: Challenge accepted and not waived by the last HOLD thirteen minutes ago. The 0% BTC-complex weight is a real under-allocation versus the numeric 40% target, and 'we already hold TSLA and SPCX' is not a reason to skip STRC/SATA. This pass did not skip them: they were priced, ranked first for a reopen, and rejected because funding them requires selling the Chairman's pin while BP is $0.03. That rebuttal is authority plus ticket funding, not illiquidity, not structure failure, and not an MSTR habit. Miner-overlap was not used as a veto; IREN and RIOT would lead a miner add and were still refused only because the sleeve is closed. A same-day dividend grab does not rescue a rotate: STRC ex-date was Sep 15 and SATA ex-date was Sep 25. Do not sell SPCX to flatten a $0.61 gap. Critic does not block the hold and does not demand a different symbol.

thesis.note: The empty 40% is the allocation fact, and the funding path is new capital, not a sale of the locked TSLA/SPCX book (Chairman 2026-09-23). A new dollar does not top up the names we already hold. It buys STRC and SATA together first (digital credit, yield vs cash, no liquidity rebuttal), then a diversified miner set (MARA, RIOT, CLSK, WULF, IREN — overlap is not a reject; today's red tape vs BTC is not thesis failure). MSTR stays behind the preferreds through the MSCI window. Stock dollars stay 50/50 TSLA/SPCX and do not lead while the complex is 0%. This pass has $0.03, so the action is hold both pins.

risk.note: Buying power $0.03 is below the $1 minimum, so no order can be sized. Guardrail is capital, not a simplified process. The pin gap is liquid (~1 bp) and inside the written ±5% band; trimming SPCX into strength would be an intraday chase, not a risk reduction. STRC and SATA are not an illiquidity problem (1 bp at par), so no stored liquidity veto against the next deposit. Miner concentration is not a block: zero miners are held. No single-name add is large enough to matter because nothing is bought. Primary margin was not in the risk budget.

critic.note: Block three bad rationales. (1) Held-only inertia: do not buy more TSLA/SPCX just because they are the book; the complex is empty and they did not win a relative-value contest against STRC/SATA. (2) Under-allocation to STRC/SATA is real and is not cured by skipping them for MSTR or for 'we will get to credit later' — they are skipped this pass only because no BTC-complex dollar is being deployed. (3) Do not reject RIOT/CLSK/WULF/MARA/IREN for miner overlap; the sleeve is empty. Also block a sale of TSLA or SPCX to force the 40% back in, and block the $4.50 pin chase (both names green, gap inside band). STRK at ~33 bp is still not the first dollar. No size-down required because size is already zero. Critic does not demand a buy.
